audit.note: the trigger press shows a static client-composed toast (control_global MESSAGE_TOAST.show) - see the IMPROVISED deviation, flagged for rework to the fragment popover

deviations.what: The shipped view is only the trigger Button plus two explanatory Texts in a VerticalLayout - rebuilt 1:1. The ProductSwitch is built in the sample's ProductSwitchPopover.fragment.xml (core:FragmentDefinition > ResponsivePopover > ProductSwitch > ProductSwitchItem, items bound to model/data.json) and opened on press (fnOpen). The port raises a client MESSAGE_TOAST instead; the ResponsivePopover, ProductSwitch and ProductSwitchItem controls are not rendered and the fnChange toast + URLHelper.redirect are lost. Review 2026-07-27: the original 'no JS controller' rationale is refuted by CAPABILITIES - a fragment popover opens 1:1 via popover_display/dependents+openBy and URLHelper redirect is expressible (cs_event-urlhelper); flagged for rework.
